solution: 'बात का बतंगड़ बनाना' - यानी किसी छोटी सी बात को बहुत बढ़ा-चढ़ा कर (exaggerate) बताना।

question: Bring someone to book
options: To write a story about a person
To teach someone how to read a book
To punish or make someone explain behavior
To give a book as a gift to someone
solution: 'जवाबदेह ठहराना' - यानी किसी को उसकी गलती के लिए दंडित (punish) करना या स्पष्टीकरण मांगना।

question: Banana oil
options: A healthy cooking ingredient
A very expensive luxury item
To be very slippery and weak
Nonsense or insincere flattery
solution: इसका अर्थ है 'बकवास' या दिखावे के लिए की जाने वाली झूठी चापलूसी (insincere flattery)।

question: By and large
options: To build a house with large rooms
To be very specific about a fact
On the whole; in general
A situation that is very complex
solution: 'कुल मिलाकर' - यानी मोटे तौर पर या सामान्य रूप से (in general)।

question: Blue blood
options: A person who has a blue skin color
To be very sad and dejected in life
A serious medical illness of blood
Noble or aristocratic ancestry
solution: 'कुलीन' - यानी ऊँचे या राजसी खानदान (noble ancestry) से संबंधित होना।

question: Buy the farm
options: To die
To be very successful in life
To buy a large area of land
To become a farmer in a village
solution: यह 'मृत्यु' (die) हो जाने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला एक मुहावरा है।

question: Big draw
options: A person or thing that attracts attention
A competition that ends in a tie
To be very tall and heavy in body
To draw a very large picture
solution: 'बड़ा आकर्षण' - यानी कोई ऐसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति जिसे देखने या सुनने के लिए बहुत भीड़ जुटे।

question: Bring the house down
options: To destroy an old building with a crane
To build a house after long years
To make an audience laugh or applaud
To stay at home during a heavy storm
solution: 'महफ़िल लूट लेना' - यानी अपने प्रदर्शन से दर्शकों की ज़ोरदार वाहवाही (applause) बटोरना।

question: Bad (or rotten) apple
options: A fruit that has gone bad
A person who dislikes healthy food
A very poor and hungry person
A person who has a bad influence on others
solution: 'एक गंदी मछली जो सारे तालाब को गंदा करे' - यानी वह व्यक्ति जो समूह के अन्य लोगों पर बुरा असर डालता है।

question: Beat the band
options: To stop a group of musicians
To an extreme degree; exceedingly
To play a musical instrument well
To win a prize in a music show
solution: इसका अर्थ है किसी चीज़ का बहुत ही तेज़ी से या अत्यधिक मात्रा (extreme degree) में होना।

question: Boil the ocean
options: To go for a swimming in very hot water
To heat a small amount of sea water
To be a very expert and brave sailor
To attempt something impossibly difficult
solution: 'पानी में आग लगाना' - यानी किसी ऐसे काम की कोशिश करना जो लगभग असंभव (impossibly difficult) हो।

question: Beyond the pale
options: To go outside the boundary of a city
A situation that is very peaceful
Outside the bounds of acceptable behaviour
To be very light in color and shape
solution: 'सीमा से बाहर' - यानी कोई ऐसा व्यवहार जो समाज में बिल्कुल भी स्वीकार्य (unacceptable) न हो।

question: Bid fair
options: To lose a game in a fair way
To seem likely to succeed or happen
To be very honest and truthful
To offer a good price in a market
solution: 'अच्छे आसार होना' - यानी जब ऐसा लगे कि किसी चीज़ में सफलता (likely to succeed) मिलने वाली है।

question: Back in the saddle
options: To go on a long holiday
To lose a position of power
To fall off a horse
Back in control or working again
solution: "Back in the saddle" का मतलब है एक ब्रेक या छुट्टी के बाद फिर से काम पर लौटना या नियंत्रण संभालना।

question: Back to the drawing board
options: To forget the past and move on
To be an expert artist
To clean a blackboard in a school
Time to start planning again after a failure
solution: जब कोई योजना विफल हो जाए और हमें नए सिरे से (planning again) सोचने की ज़रूरत हो।

question: Bridge the gap
options: To travel to a far and new country
To follow a set of instructions carefully
To build a bridge over a large river
To reduce differences between two things
solution: 'अंतर कम करना' - यानी दो पक्षों या चीज़ों के बीच के मतभेदों (differences) को सुलझाना या कम करना।

question: Be afraid of one's own shadow
options: To be very strong and brave
To follow someone secretly
To be extremely timid or easily frightened
To walk in a dark place at night
solution: 'अपनी परछाई से डरना' - यानी जो व्यक्ति स्वभाव से बहुत अधिक डरपोक (timid) हो।

question: Blue-eyed boy
options: A person with a medical eye problem
To wear a blue contact lens in eyes
A person who is always very sad
A person treated with special favour
solution: 'आँखों का तारा' - यानी वह व्यक्ति जो सबका बहुत चहेता हो और जिसे विशेष लाड़-प्यार (special favour) मिले।

question: Box someone's ear
options: To listen to a secret very carefully
To wear earrings in a formal party
To slap someone on the ear
To give a gift of an earring to someone
solution: 'कान के नीचे जड़ देना' - यानी किसी के कान पर ज़ोर से थप्पड़ (slap) मारना।

question: Bring home the bacon
options: To cook a delicious meal at home
To receive a gift from a relative
To buy meat for the entire family
To earn money for family; to succeed
solution: 'रोज़ी-रोटी कमाना' - यानी परिवार के पालन-पोषण के लिए पैसा कमाना या सफलता प्राप्त करना।

question: Bury one's head in the sand
options: To hide from a dangerous enemy
To refuse to deal with a problem
To play on a beach during a holiday
To be very brave in a difficult time
solution: 'समस्या से मुँह मोड़ना' - यानी किसी बड़ी परेशानी को अनदेखा (refuse to deal) करना जैसे कि वह है ही नहीं।

question: Bite the bullet
options: To use a gun in a war
To be very lucky in a dangerous time
To start a fight with a powerful person
To accept a difficult situation bravely
solution: 'कड़वा घूँट पीना' - यानी किसी बहुत ही कठिन या अप्रिय स्थिति को मज़बूरी में बहादुरी (bravely) से स्वीकार करना।

question: Beat one's brains out
options: To be very foolish and stupid
To try very hard to think or remember
To have a serious head injury
To ignore an important problem
solution: 'सिर खपाना' - यानी किसी चीज़ को याद करने या हल ढूँढने के लिए अपने दिमाग पर बहुत अधिक ज़ोर (try very hard) डालना।

question: Build castles in the air
options: To have dreams unlikely to happen
To build a house on a very high place
To fly a kite in a clear blue sky
To be an expert architect in a city
solution: 'हवाई किले बनाना' - यानी ऐसी काल्पनिक योजनाएँ बनाना जिनका हकीकत में सच होना मुश्किल (unlikely to happen) हो।

question: Beat the drum for
options: To play a drum in a festival
To make a lot of noise in a street
To speak enthusiastically in support
To be against a new project
solution: 'ढोल पीटना' - यानी किसी विचार या व्यक्ति के समर्थन (support) में ज़ोर-शोर से प्रचार करना।

question: By word of mouth
options: To speak in a very loud and angry voice
To share a secret with only one friend
To have a medical problem in mouth
Told from person to person verbally
solution: 'मौखिक रूप से' - यानी वह जानकारी या खबर जो लिखित रूप में नहीं बल्कि लोगों की बातचीत (verbally) के ज़रिए फैली हो।
